from AlgorithmImports import *

class SpecifiedStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.strategy_a_percent = 0.10

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return
            bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        self.spy_sma.Update(self.Time, spy_close)

        previous_aapl_close = self.aapl_previous_close
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(self.Time, aapl_close)

        if previous_aapl_close is None:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        elif aapl_close < previous_aapl_close:
            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        fully_formed = (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.spy_previous_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_aapl_close is not None
        )

        if not self.IsWarmingUp and fully_formed:
            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.spy_previous_close <= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )
            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.spy_previous_close >= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )

            # Sells before buys.
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * self.strategy_a_percent) // spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = shares

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        self.spy_previous_close = spy_close
        self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class PrivateLotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.a_lot = 0
        self.b_lot = 0

        self.strategy_a_percent = 1.0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                close = data.Bars[symbol].Close
                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_closes.Add(close)
                elif symbol == self.aapl:
                    self.aapl_closes.Add(close)

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        if (not self.spy_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        current_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        previous_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
        previous_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]
        current_spy_close = spy_bar.Close

        spy_crosses_above = (
            previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma and
            current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma and
            current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        aapl_red_three_days = (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
            self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
            self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

        # Sells before buys
        if self.a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.a_lot)
            self.a_lot = 0

        if self.b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.b_lot)
            self.b_lot = 0

        if self.a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = int(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * self.strategy_a_percent)
                / current_spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.a_lot = shares

        if self.b_lot == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            purchase_amount = 20_000
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= purchase_amount:
                shares = int(purchase_amount / aapl_bar.Close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.b_lot = shares
